context:
Goal: a builder cannot undo earlier lane work, and the check does not cry wolf.
Problem (rule): you asked for a against b (08:03 CST). One Sonnet agent argued both on the 31-batch sweep; options c and d are dropped from this item.
Based on (measured): the first real undo, 3297d8fa, has a hunk that lost exactly 6 lines, so a misses that hunk; only the whole-file read keeps it red. A weakened test (1807d3708, ce60895c9) sat in the 1 to 6 line band.
Based on (measured): of 15 flags in the 1 to 6 band, 0 were silent undos: 8 were noise (reworded comments, a moved helper, fixture rewrites) and 6 were deliberate re-points.
Based on (notes): a cuts reason lines from 41 to about 21 and red batches from 16 to about 11-13 of 31 (the agent's estimate; a is not built).
Departs from: main, which has no net-loss read — adds one in the shape you pick.

Meanwhile: PR #1099 waits with the batch runner as shape b; the lane builds nothing until you pick.

lastAnswer.note: Read 17:48 CST. Filed 17:56 CST in decision silent-undo-check-design, PR #1099 (head 1e029e0b). Closes when #1099 merges.

options.gain: About 20 fewer reason lines per 3 days, and fewer red batches.
options.label: Flag past 6 lines
options.lose: A loss of 1 to 6 test lines, a flipped assert included, passes with no word.

options.gain: Every lane test-line loss carries a stated reason.
options.how: Every net loss flags; the builder clears it with one line in the commit saying why the tests went. This is the check as built in PR #1099.
options.label: Flag any loss, cleared by one reason line (recommended)
options.lose: About 41 reason lines per 3 days (62 flags; one line covers its path). A reason written early for a path also excuses a later real drop in that file, so there the reviewer is the only check.

ref: decision no-undo-lane-commits (PR #1099); one Sonnet agent's verdict via lane lane-undo-check, 08:14 CST; page item 167
short: No-undo: past 6 lines, or any loss
title: No-undo check: flag a lane's test-line loss past 6 lines, or flag any loss with one reason line?
why: Recommended: b, the check as built today. 6 is main's block size, not a measured tolerance, and a weakened test sat in the 1 to 6 line band.
